Topographic contours

CUsage rules
Line weight
One weight for every line: 1.5 px at 1× on screen, 0.25 pt in print.
Opacity
Lines sit at 25–45%. Behind body copy, drop to 15% or less.
Highlight
One contour at most, in Orange or Lime at 3× weight, to point at the key message.
Scale & crop
Scale uniformly and crop freely. Keep at least 3 rings visible so it reads as terrain.
Logo
Contours may run behind the logo, but never inside its ½X clear space at full opacity.
